title: Dashboard usability: memory editor cards + tag audit + task page layout
description:
## Human Auditing / Dashboard Usability Improvements

Performed July 2026 changes based on kb-graph-rag-audit UX feedback and the `task-page-fix-7-10-26.png` mockup.

### Memory Editor Changes
1. **Removed uneditable ID field** — the read-only ID no longer clutters the editor grid
2. **Title spans full width** — `wiki-editor-title-full` class sets `grid-column: 1 / -1`
3. **Confidence gets label + textbox + slider** — label "Confidence", a text field for direct percentage entry, and the existing slider in a 3-column grid
4. **References as card list** — replaced simple comma-text field with `MudAutocomplete` cards; each card has a searchable dropdown for memory IDs, and an X button to remove. Add button appends new cards.
5. **Conflicts as card list** — same card pattern as references
6. **Source Links as card list** — each source link is a row with a Type dropdown (Code/Docs/Web/Config/Test/Other), URI text field, optional Line Range field, and X delete button. Add button appends new rows.
7. **Tag audit panel** — shows policy-blocked tags in red chips with per-chip remove and "Remove all" bulk action. Backed by `TagGovernanceService.GetProhibitedTags()`

### Task Page Changes
1. **Removed separate status section** (`tasks-detail-status-panel` div deleted)
2. **Status dropdown moved into overview grid** — now sits alongside Assignee/Type/Reporter/Updated in the `tasks-detail-overview` grid as a first-class card
3. **Comments/Artifacts/History tabs min-height fix** — `.tasks-workbench .mud-tabs-panels` changed from `min-height: 0` to `min-height: 250px` with `flex: 1 1 auto` so the tab content area doesn't collapse to zero

### Files Changed
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/MemoryViewer.razor` — editor grid, code-behind fields/methods
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Tasks.razor` — detail summary section
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/TagGovernanceService.cs` — added `GetProhibitedTags()`
- `MemorySmith.App/wwwroot/app.css` — new CSS for refcards, confidence, tag audit, task tabs

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Editor opens without ID field visible
- [ ] Title stretches full width of editor
- [ ] Confidence shows label, text input for percentage, and slider — all three update each other
- [ ] References show as auto-complete cards with X delete; adding a new one via search + add button
- [ ] Conflicts same pattern as references
- [ ] Source Links show as cards with type dropdown, URI field, line range, X delete
- [ ] Tags with policy violations show red audit panel with per-chip and bulk remove
- [ ] Task detail page has status inline in the overview grid, not as a separate section
- [ ] Tabs area (comments/artifacts/history) has at least 250px min height
